notes: Set HOME to fixture_root, or GEMINI_DATA_DIR to <fixture_root>/.gemini/tmp, to point a parser at this tree.
Working directory comes from .gemini/projects.json (path -> slug) or from .gemini/tmp/<slug>/.project_root. It is not in the chat file.
provider is not written by the harness. 'google' is the only provider gemini-cli talks to for these models, so a parser must supply it.
tokens.input (promptTokenCount) INCLUDES tokens.cached (cachedContentTokenCount), so uncached_input = input - cached.
cache write is never reported by the Gemini API usageMetadata, so cache_write is always 0.
tokens.tool (toolUsePromptTokenCount) is a separate prompt-side count, not inside promptTokenCount.
The file is append-only JSONL. Message id a71c4e52... appears twice: once with tokens null, once with tokens filled. Last line for an id wins.
Lines with $set are metadata updates and carry no usage. Lines with $rewindTo (not present here) truncate history back to an id.
